# Implementation Plan: Overview-Data Split

*Generated by `/plan-with-ralph` on 2026-05-17. Ready for `/implement-with-ralph --from-plan <job_dir>/plan.md`.*

## Overview

Hoist all per-task definitions out of `plans/overview.html` (3770 lines) into a new sidecar `plans/overview-data.js`. The HTML becomes a thin shell of empty containers + render JS. A single `window.OVERVIEW_DATA = {...}` object becomes the source of truth for kanban cards, ralph command rows, phase tree, and the existing runs/periodic/cadence/lastTouched metadata. Bookkeeper procedures collapse from "edit 4–6 places per task state change" to "edit one block in one JS file." This is plan #2 of three siblings (`plans/task-phases.md` ✅ shipped, `plans/overview-vite-react.md` depends on this).

The data file is `.js` (not `.json`) because the page renders from `file://` and Chromium blocks `fetch` on local-file origins. A `<script src="overview-data.js">` works without CORS. Plan #3 (Vite + React) consumes `window.OVERVIEW_DATA` from the same file — its `App.tsx::getSnapshot()` and Vite HMR plugin are already drafted against this contract.

## Research Findings

### Codebase Context

`plans/overview.html` verified at 3770 lines with sections at confirmed ranges:
- **Header + CSS + scripts:** 1–1082 (phase-badge classes at 852–880, `.cmd-status-mod` at 862–874 — preserve verbatim, render JS emits the same class names)
- **Kanban (3 columns):** 1083–1425, ~50 cards in `<div class="col">` containers. **Multiple cards per task exist:** `1b-multidev`, `polish-Fs`, `perf-WS2`, `agent-comms` each render >1 card (Codex confirmed). Schema must use `kanbanCards[]`, not single `kanbanColumn`.
- **Ralph command rows:** 1442–1914, **51 `<details class="cmd">` rows** (not "~50" — Codex precise count). Each row already carries `data-task-id`, `data-task-scope`, `data-task-phase`, `data-task-status`; some carry `data-plan-only="true"` (3 rows) and `data-merge-commit="<sha>"` (6 rows). Plan #1 (`task-phases.md`) shipped these attributes in commits `41ffa876..5a369d6f` + post-merge fixes F-003..F-007.
- **Phase tree (`<details class="section sec-roadmap">`):** 1920–2009. **NOT task-derived** (Copilot): bullets like `1b.1` and `4a-4m` exist without task IDs. Dedicated `phaseTree` schema required (user decision).
- **`<script type="application/json" id="roadmap-data">`:** 2180–2612 (~430 lines, closing `</script>` at 2612). Holds `generatedAt`, `generatedFromCommit`, `lastTouched`, `runs`, `periodic`, `cadence`, **plus map-shaped metadata** `effort`, `risk`, `workstream`, `sizeBucket`, `spawnedFrom` (Copilot caught — draft only mentioned `runs/periodic/cadence/lastTouched`). All of it must move into `window.OVERVIEW_DATA`, not just the four named fields.
- **Inline JS:** 2614–3767. Key functions: `getRoadmapData()` (3530–3533), `renderPhaseBadges()` (2729–2762), URL filter `parseTaskIdFilter()` (3206–3254) — **URL param is `?tasks=`, not `?id=`** (Codex). Section counts populators (3070–3096), localStorage `codexu-overview-details-state-v2` (3106), spawn relationships (3554–3570).

Scope values present in the codebase: `codexu`, `codex`, `codex|codexu`, `bookkeeping|codexu`. Schema must keep `scope` as a free string, not a `"codex"|"codexu"` union.

### Technical Constraints

1. **`file://` compatibility forces `.js`.** No alternative.
2. **Plan #3 contract:** `window.OVERVIEW_DATA = { generatedAt, generatedFromCommit, tasks, phaseTree, runs, periodic, cadence, lastTouched, effort, risk, workstream, sizeBucket, spawnedFrom };` — single top-level assignment, no IIFE, no conditionals (Vite HMR friendliness, `plans/overview-vite-react.md` lines 74–88). `generatedAt` and `generatedFromCommit` stay at the top level (not under a `meta:{}` wrapper) because existing consumers in `plans/overview.html` already read them at top level: the freshness-hint IIFE at line 3540 reads `data.generatedFromCommit` and line 3543 reads `data.generatedAt`.
3. **Render order:** data-driven render must execute BEFORE existing IIFEs (`renderPhaseBadges`, `injectTaskScopeChips`, counts, filters, spawn injection, run history). The simplest path: rebuild `getRoadmapData()` to return `window.OVERVIEW_DATA` synchronously and run a `renderTasks()` + `renderPhaseTree()` pass at the top of DOMContentLoaded, before everything else.
4. **DOM contracts to re-emit verbatim** on rendered rows (consumed by existing IIFEs):
   - `id="cmd-${task.id}"` (hash links)
   - `data-task-id`, `data-task-phase`, `data-task-status`, `data-task-scope`, optional `data-plan-only`, `data-merge-commit`
   - Kanban `<div class="card">` with `data-task-id`, optional extra class (e.g. `class="card closed"` at line 1174), and optional inline `style` (`border-color`, `opacity`). Conditional inline styles `phase === "shipped"` → `border-color: var(--ok); opacity: 0.8` and `status === "paused"` → `border-color: var(--muted); opacity: 0.7` are NOT derivable in all cases (e.g. `class="card closed"` carries no phase/status mapping); the per-card `cardClass` and `inlineStyle` fields are authoritative. The card body itself contains rich HTML (37 `.card-meta` blocks with `<span class="pill">`, `<a>`, inline `<code>`, ordered text fragments) that cannot be reconstructed from flat title/sub fields.
5. **HTML entity decoding in prompt bodies.** ~50 prompt strings contain `&lt;`, `&gt;`, `&amp;` for shell metacharacters like `2&gt;&amp;1`. Decode once when porting; re-emit on render via `textContent`-style assignment (not `innerHTML`) to round-trip identically.
6. **Rich description content.** `cmd-desc` blocks contain inline `<code>` and `<a>` tags; warnings are ordered rich text; some tasks have no command body. Schema needs `descriptionHtml` (trusted HTML fragment) plus structured `warnings[]`, not flat strings.

## Approach

### Architecture

**Single data file.** `plans/overview-data.js` is one top-level assignment. Top of file: a schema comment block (copied from this plan's "Data schema" section below). Body: `window.OVERVIEW_DATA = { ... };`.

**Render pipeline in `overview.html`:**
1. `<script src="overview-data.js">` loads before the main inline `<script>`.
2. New `renderTasks()` walks `OVERVIEW_DATA.tasks` and emits kanban cards into `#kanban-ready` / `#kanban-soon` / `#kanban-blocked`, plus command rows into `#cmd-list` — re-emitting DOM contracts (id, data-* attributes, inline style). Each kanban card is emitted as `<div class="card${card.cardClass ? ' ' + card.cardClass : ''}"${card.inlineStyle ? ' style="' + card.inlineStyle + '"' : ''} data-task-id="${task.id}">${card.html}</div>` so rich card-meta content (pills, icons, links, inline `<code>`) round-trips verbatim.
3. New `renderPhaseTree()` walks `OVERVIEW_DATA.phaseTree` and emits nested phase nodes into `#phase-tree`.
4. Existing IIFEs (`renderPhaseBadges`, `injectTaskScopeChips`, counts, filters, URL banner, spawn injection, run history, persistence) run as-is against the freshly-emitted DOM — no rewrites needed beyond ordering.
5. **`<details>` open-state preserve/restore:** at the top of `renderTasks()`, snapshot `Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('details.cmd[open]')).map(el => el.id)` into a local Set; after re-render, walk the Set and set `el.open = true`. Plus the existing localStorage v2 persistence re-applies on the new DOM.

**Render JS stays inline in `overview.html`.** Don't extract to `overview-render.js` in this plan (architect recommendation). Plan #3 will reorganize render anyway when Vite/React lands.

### Data schema

```js
// plans/overview-data.js
// Single source of truth for the overview viewer. Edit this file to change
// task state; do NOT edit plans/overview.html directly.

window.OVERVIEW_DATA = {
  // Top-level (NOT under meta:{}) — existing consumers in overview.html read
  // data.generatedFromCommit (line 3540) and data.generatedAt (line 3543) directly.
  generatedAt: "<ISO8601>",
  generatedFromCommit: "<sha>",
  tasks: [
    {
      id: "perf-WS3",                              // load-bearing: id="cmd-${id}"
      title: "Realtime sync perf — WS3: ...",
      scope: "codexu",                             // free string: codex | codexu | "codex|codexu" | "bookkeeping|codexu"
      phase: "shipped",                            // 10-value enum from plans/task-phases.md
      status: "ok",                                // ok | blocked | paused
      planOnly: false,                             // mirrors data-plan-only
      mergeCommit: "197b0148",                     // mirrors data-merge-commit; null unless shipped
      planSource: "fresh",                         // fresh | from-brainstorm | from-plan-doc | planOnly
      planSourceRef: null,                         // relative path for from-plan-doc; null otherwise
      planJobId: null,                             // .ralph/jobs/<id> when populated
      command: {
        summaryHtml: "...",                        // <summary> inner HTML, trusted fragment
        descriptionHtml: "...",                    // .cmd-desc inner HTML (may contain <code>, <a>)
        warnings: [                                // ordered; render in array order
          { kind: "blocked", html: "Wait until perf-WS3 lands." }
        ],
        planPrompt: "/plan-with-ralph \"...\""     // decoded shell-safe string; render via textContent
      },
      kanbanCards: [                               // 0..n entries (multiple cards per task allowed)
        {
          column: "ready",                          // ready | soon | blocked
          cardClass: null,                          // extra class on outer <div class="card ${cardClass}">, e.g. "closed"; null for none
          inlineStyle: null,                        // verbatim inline style string, e.g. "border-color: var(--ok); opacity: 0.8;"; null for none
          html: "..."                               // trusted full inner HTML of <div class="card"> — round-trips title, sub, card-meta pills/icons/links/<code> exactly
        }
      ],
      spawnedFrom: null,                            // parent task id; reverse-index for children built at render time
      lastTouchedAt: "2026-05-13T22:00:00Z"
    }
    // ... 48 more
  ],
  phaseTree: [
    // Each phase node renders as <div class="phase"> with .phase-head + (<ul> or <details class="phase-subdetails">).
    // Schema is rich enough to round-trip state classes ("open"|"deferred"|"donefade"|"closed"),
    // inline styles (e.g. style="color: var(--warn);"), <span class="ptag">…</span> in headers,
    // and nested <details class="phase-subdetails"> collapsibles. See overview.html lines 1920–2009.
    {
      id: "phase-1",
      title: "Phase 1 — Foundations",            // plain text portion of <div class="phase-head">
      headerHtml: null,                           // optional trusted inner HTML for .phase-head; overrides `title` when set
                                                  //   (use for headers with <span class="ptag"> or other rich content)
      collapsible: false,                         // when true, wrap items in <details class="phase-subdetails"><summary>…</summary>
      collapsibleSummary: null,                   // text shown in the <summary> when collapsible:true (e.g. "13 sub-items (all blocked) — click to expand")
      nodes: [
        // task-ref: emit <li><span class="item-name ${state}">…</span>${trailingHtml}</li>.
        // `state` is one of the four CSS state classes — load-bearing for styling.
        { kind: "task-ref", taskId: "perf-WS3", state: "open",
          trailingHtml: " — docs-only, open" },   // optional rich tail after the .item-name span; null when none
        // raw: trusted full <li>…</li> inner HTML. Use for bullets without a task id,
        // entries that carry inline style (e.g. style="color: var(--warn);"),
        // or composite lines that mix multiple .item-name spans on a single bullet.
        { kind: "raw", html: "<span class=\"item-name closed\">Polish PR — F-013 closed</span> · <span class=\"item-name open\">F-015 / F-017</span> — low-risk isolated" },
        // sub-phase: recursive phase node (rendered as a nested <div class="phase"> if needed).
        { kind: "sub-phase", id: "1b", title: "…", headerHtml: null,
          collapsible: false, collapsibleSummary: null, nodes: [ /* recursive */ ] }
      ]
    }
    // ... more phases
  ],
  // Map-shaped metadata moved verbatim from existing inline JSON:
  runs: [ /* verbatim */ ],
  periodic: { /* verbatim */ },
  cadence: { /* verbatim */ },
  lastTouched: { /* verbatim — superseded by per-task lastTouchedAt but kept for compatibility */ },
  effort: { /* verbatim, keyed by task id */ },
  risk: { /* verbatim */ },
  workstream: { /* verbatim */ },
  sizeBucket: { /* verbatim */ },
  spawnedFrom: { /* verbatim, keyed by task id; redundant with task.spawnedFrom but kept for existing IIFE compatibility */ }
};
```

### Implementation Strategy

Five ordered stories. US-001/US-002 are foundation (must serialize). US-003/US-004/US-005 can run in parallel after US-002, with US-003 and US-004 carrying medium file-overlap risk on `overview.html` and `overview-data.js` (disjoint line ranges but same files).

1. **US-001 (foundation):** Create `overview-data.js` with the schema comment and `window.OVERVIEW_DATA = { generatedAt, generatedFromCommit, tasks: [], phaseTree: [], runs, periodic, cadence, lastTouched, effort, risk, workstream, sizeBucket, spawnedFrom };`. Keep `generatedAt` and `generatedFromCommit` at the top level (not wrapped under `meta:{}`) so the existing freshness-hint consumer at `plans/overview.html:3540` (`data.generatedFromCommit`) and `:3543` (`data.generatedAt`) keeps working without rewrite. Move **every** map from the existing inline JSON verbatim — including `effort`, `risk`, `workstream`, `sizeBucket`, `spawnedFrom`. Delete the `<script type="application/json" id="roadmap-data">` block from HTML. Add `<script src="overview-data.js">` immediately before the main inline `<script>`. Rewrite `getRoadmapData()` to return `window.OVERVIEW_DATA`. Page must render identically (tasks/tree still inline in HTML for now) — verify the SHA-in-header (`#gen-sha`) and freshness hint (`#freshness-hint`) populate as before.

2. **US-002 (representative-port):** Pick 3 representative tasks that exercise the schema corners: `perf-WS3` (shipped + `mergeCommit`), `1b-multidev` (multiple kanban cards, paused/blocked semantics), `polish-Fs` (rich warnings). Extract them into `tasks[]` with full `command` and `kanbanCards[]` populated. Add `renderTasks()` that emits **only these 3** by id from data, while leaving the other 47 HTML-authored rows in place. Implement the `<details>` open-state preserve/restore in this story. Verify visually: the 3 data-rendered rows are pixel-identical to the (still-present) HTML rows. Then delete the original HTML for those 3.

3. **US-003 (full task port):** Extract the remaining 48 tasks. Delete all original HTML kanban cards and `<details class="cmd">` rows. `renderTasks()` now drives the entire kanban + command sections. Update section-count populators if their selectors broke. All filter/search/URL-banner/hash-nav/spawn-injection IIFEs must continue working unchanged.

4. **US-004 (phase tree port):** Build `phaseTree[]` by walking `overview.html` lines 1920–2009 and capturing every node. For each bullet, choose the schema variant: a single `<span class="item-name ${state}">` followed by optional trailing text → `{kind:"task-ref", taskId, state, trailingHtml}` (resolve `taskId` from the visible text against `tasks[]`); anything else (no task id, inline style, multiple `.item-name` spans on one line, or other rich `<li>` content) → `{kind:"raw", html}` carrying the verbatim `<li>` inner HTML. For each phase node, capture `headerHtml` when the `.phase-head` contains `<span class="ptag">…</span>`, and set `collapsible:true` + `collapsibleSummary` for phases 4 and 5 whose items live inside `<details class="phase-subdetails">`. Add `renderPhaseTree()` that emits `<div class="phase"><div class="phase-head">…</div>` followed by either `<ul>` items or the `<details class="phase-subdetails"><summary>` wrapper, with each `task-ref` rendered as `<span class="item-name ${state}">${task.title or visibleText}</span>${trailingHtml||""}` and each `raw` node injected via `innerHTML`. Delete the original phase tree HTML. Cross-link `task-ref` nodes to `tasks[id]` for highlighted phase pills.

5. **US-005 (docs + skill rewrite):** Rewrite `.agents/skills/roadmap-and-overview/SKILL.md` procedures A–G to describe data-file edits (single JSON entry append/edit). Fix the `codexu-overview-details-state-v1` → `v2` drift Copilot caught. Update the "Pitfalls" section with JS string escaping guidance (HTML entity decoding, template-literal backtick escaping). Update `plans/codexu-roadmap.md` Companion-snapshot callout (lines 5–9) and Task-phase-model rule (line 175). Update `plans/parallel-assignments.md` top to add a "data file is source of truth" note; keep the bottom status table as a derived view. Repo-wide grep for stale `edit plans/overview.html` instructions; update each (known: `plans/agent-view-research.md`, `plans/codex-agent-parity-audit.md` line 1358, and the `roadmap-plugin` prompt body).

## Risk Areas

1. **HTML-entity decoding on prompt bodies.** ~51 prompt strings contain `&lt;`, `&gt;`, `&amp;` in shell metacharacters. **Mitigation:** when porting, decode entities exactly once (e.g. via a DOMParser one-shot or `textarea.innerHTML = x; textarea.value` in a Node script). Use single-quoted JS string literals with `\'` escapes (not template literals — backticks collide with markdown backticks inside prompts). Manually diff the first 3 and last 3 prompts as written-vs-original before committing US-003.

2. **Multiple kanban cards per task.** Codex confirmed `1b-multidev`, `polish-Fs`, `perf-WS2`, `agent-comms` each render >1 card. Schema uses `kanbanCards[]`, render emits per-card.

3. **Phase tree contains non-task bullets, state classes, inline styles, and nested collapsibles.** `1b.1`, `4a-4m`, etc. have no task ids. `.item-name` carries one of four state CSS classes (`open|deferred|donefade|closed`) that drive strike-through and color. Some bullets carry inline `style="color: var(--warn);"`. Phases 4 and 5 wrap their items in `<details class="phase-subdetails"><summary>…</summary>`. Phase headers can carry `<span class="ptag">…</span>`. Schema uses `{kind:"task-ref", taskId, state, trailingHtml?}` for task-linked bullets and `{kind:"raw", html}` for everything else (trusted inner HTML round-trips inline styles and composite lines verbatim); phase nodes carry optional `headerHtml`, `collapsible`, and `collapsibleSummary` to round-trip header rich content and the `phase-subdetails` wrappers.

4. **Render-order dependency.** Existing IIFEs assume DOM is pre-populated. `renderTasks()` and `renderPhaseTree()` must run synchronously and before everything else.

5. **`<details>` open-state preserve/restore correctness.** Snapshot via `document.querySelectorAll('details.cmd[open]').map(el => el.id)` BEFORE the wipe; re-apply by id AFTER render. Combine with existing localStorage v2 logic.

6. **Section counts and filters operate on DOM.** Existing counts IIFEs (3070–3096) and filter IIFE (3265–3301) read DOM attributes. As long as render emits the same `data-*` attributes, no changes needed.

7. **Skill rewrite scope.** SKILL.md is 548 lines; the rewrite touches Procedures A–G plus Pitfalls. Risk of drift between SKILL example snippets and the actual data-file shape. Mitigation: write SKILL.md AFTER US-003/US-004 finalize the schema; reference one canonical task entry in the SKILL as a working example.

8. **C/D parallel file overlap.** US-003 and US-004 both write to `overview.html` and `overview-data.js`, in disjoint line ranges. Parallel execution requires per-story worktree branches and a clean merge step; the orchestrator should handle but worktrees must be coordinated.

9. **Trusted-HTML escape hatch in `kanbanCards[].html` and phaseTree `raw` nodes.** Both schemas carry a `string` of inner HTML that the renderer emits via DOM-string assignment (`innerHTML` / `outerHTML` / template-string interpolation). The escape hatch is deliberate: rich `.card-meta` content (pills, icons, `<code>`, `<a>`) and phase-tree structural bullets (`1b.1`, `4a-4m` with inline styles) are too irregular to round-trip from structured fields without high risk of corruption in v1. **Security:** the data file is operator/agent-authored, not user-input — trust is by convention, same as the current authored HTML. **Plan #3 (overview-vite-react) ripple:** the React port must consume these fragments via `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` (or equivalent) on `<KanbanCard>` and `<PhaseTreeNode>` raw branches. Reconstructing them as JSX is out of scope for both plans. This plan does NOT widen the escape hatch to `command.descriptionHtml` or warnings — those are constrained enough to round-trip via structured fields if a future plan wants tighter typing.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `plans/overview-data.js` exists with 49 task entries, full `phaseTree`, and all map metadata (`effort`, `risk`, `workstream`, `sizeBucket`, `spawnedFrom`, `runs`, `periodic`, `cadence`, `lastTouched`) ported verbatim from the existing inline JSON.
- [ ] `plans/overview.html` no longer contains: the `<script type="application/json" id="roadmap-data">` block, any `<details class="cmd">` rows, any kanban `<div class="card">` blocks, or the phase tree section.
- [ ] `plans/overview.html` still contains: all `<style>` blocks (especially phase-badge CSS at 852–880 and `.cmd-status-mod` at 862–874), section headers, legend, URL filter banner DOM, search input, all existing inline JS IIFEs except where explicitly refactored.
- [ ] Opening `plans/overview.html` from `file://` (double-click) renders identically to the pre-refactor version: same kanban columns + cards, same phase tree, same `<details>` rows with the same `<summary>` titles, same prompt bodies copy-pasteable from the clipboard, same filter/search/URL banner behavior, same hash navigation (`#cmd-<id>` jumps to the matching row).
- [ ] Prompt bodies in `<pre class="cmd-pre">` render with HTML entities decoded to literal characters; the render path assigns prompt strings via `textContent` (or equivalent DOM `Node.textContent` assignment / `document.createTextNode`), never via `innerHTML` or template-string interpolation into an HTML fragment. Verified by manual copy-paste check on the first 3 and last 3 tasks (by `tasks[]` order): pasted clipboard text equals the JS string literal stored in `tasks[].command.planPrompt` byte-for-byte (no `&gt;`, `&lt;`, `&amp;`, or other entity round-trip artifacts).
- [ ] Expanding a `<details class="cmd">` row, then re-firing the render (e.g. via console-invoked `renderTasks()`), preserves the open state.
- [ ] Bookkeeper workflow: flipping a task's `phase` from `impl-in-progress` to `shipped` requires editing exactly one entry in `overview-data.js` and zero edits to `overview.html`. The change reflects in kanban placement, command-row badge, phase tree pill, and Today panel without further file edits.
- [ ] Today-panel verification: after a data-file edit changing a task's `phase` to `impl-in-progress`, opening `plans/overview.html` from `file://` (single page reload) places that task's id-chip in the Today panel's "🟡 Running" row (`#today-running`), with no console errors. Verified by manual reload. Confirms `buildTodayPanel()` at line 2984 (which walks `document.querySelectorAll('details.cmd')` and reads `data-task-id` + status precedence) still classifies the freshly-rendered DOM correctly.

## Preliminary Story Decomposition

6 stories across 4 phases. US-001 → US-002 sequential foundation. US-003, US-004, US-005a parallelizable in Phase 3. US-005b is Phase 4 because the SKILL examples reference the finalized schema.

- **US-001 foundation** — scaffold `overview-data.js` with full top-level skeleton (empty `tasks: []`, empty `phaseTree: []`), move ALL inline JSON verbatim, switch `getRoadmapData()`
- **US-002 representative-port** — port `perf-WS3` + `1b-multidev` + `polish-Fs` into `tasks[]`, add `renderTasks()` + `<details>` open-state preserve/restore, emit both inline-script section markers (`renderTasks` and `renderPhaseTree` stub)
- **US-003 full task port** — extract remaining 48 tasks, delete original HTML kanban + command rows
- **US-004 phase tree port** — extract phase tree into `phaseTree[]`, add `renderPhaseTree()`, delete original tree HTML
- **US-005a docs sweep** (schema-shape-independent, parallel-safe in Phase 3) — update `codexu-roadmap.md`, `parallel-assignments.md`, `agent-view-research.md`, `codex-agent-parity-audit.md`, `overview-vite-react.md` (the `?id=`→`?tasks=` fix), and the `roadmap-plugin` prompt body in the same edit. No SKILL.md changes here.
- **US-005b SKILL rewrite** (Phase 4, depends on US-003 + US-004) — rewrite `.agents/skills/roadmap-and-overview/SKILL.md` procedures A–G with a working example task entry that references the final schema (`kanbanCards`, `phaseTree` nodes, `lastTouched` dual-update invariant). Fix the `v1`→`v2` localStorage key drift. Add Pitfalls entries for JS string escaping and the `lastTouched` dual-update.

The split resolves F-013's ordering tension: US-005a contains only schema-shape-independent doc edits (parallel-safe with US-003/US-004); US-005b owns the SKILL rewrite, which must see the final schema US-003 and US-004 settle.

(Full story bodies with acceptance criteria in `<job_dir>/stories-outline.md`.)

## Suggested Decomposition

Six clusters across four phases. US-001 → US-002 must serialize (scaffold + render-pipeline foundation). US-003, US-004, US-005a run in parallel in Phase 3 with documented file-overlap risk between US-003 and US-004. US-005b is Phase 4 (depends on the final schema from US-003 + US-004).

### Cluster: foundation
- Stories: US-001
- Phase: 1
- Depends on: None
- File-overlap evidence: shared=[plans/overview.html, plans/overview-data.js]; exclusive=[]; risk=low
- `execution_mode` rationale: Foundation story has no dependencies. It owns the entire data file at creation time and the inline-JSON deletion + script-tag addition in HTML.

### Cluster: representative-port
- Stories: US-002
- Phase: 2
- Depends on: foundation
- File-overlap evidence: shared=[plans/overview.html, plans/overview-data.js]; exclusive=[]; risk=low
- `execution_mode` rationale: Establishes the render pipeline + DOM contract + open-state preserve/restore before the bulk port. Must serialize after US-001 because both touch the same files and US-002 reads the data-file scaffold US-001 created.

### Cluster: full-task-port
- Stories: US-003
- Phase: 3
- Depends on: representative-port
- File-overlap evidence: shared=[plans/overview.html (lines 1083–1425, 1442–1914), plans/overview-data.js (tasks[])]; exclusive=[]; risk=medium
- `execution_mode` rationale: Heavy mechanical extraction of 46 tasks. Disjoint line ranges from US-004 in `overview.html` (kanban + command rows vs phase tree), but same file. Worktree merge handles disjoint ranges cleanly. The render pipeline from US-002 is the contract.

### Cluster: phase-tree-port
- Stories: US-004
- Phase: 3
- Depends on: representative-port
- File-overlap evidence: shared=[plans/overview.html (lines 1920–2009 deletion + new render code in inline `<script>`), plans/overview-data.js (phaseTree field)]; exclusive=[]; risk=medium
- `execution_mode` rationale: Independent extraction of the phase tree section. File-overlap with US-003 is on `overview.html` (disjoint line ranges: phase tree vs kanban/commands) and `overview-data.js` (additive: `phaseTree` field vs `tasks[]` entries). Both stories add code into the inline `<script>` block — care needed to avoid stomping each other's `renderTasks()` / `renderPhaseTree()` insertions; recommend placing each in a clearly-marked section.

### Cluster: docs-sweep
- Stories: US-005a
- Phase: 3
- Depends on: representative-port
- File-overlap evidence: shared=[]; exclusive=[plans/codexu-roadmap.md, plans/parallel-assignments.md, plans/agent-view-research.md, plans/codex-agent-parity-audit.md, plans/overview-vite-react.md]; risk=low
- `execution_mode` rationale: Schema-shape-independent. Only renames "edit plans/overview.html" → "edit plans/overview-data.js" and similar stale-doc fixes (including `?id=`→`?tasks=` in plans/overview-vite-react.md). Touches no files that US-003 or US-004 touch; safe to run fully in parallel with both. Resolves F-013's ordering tension by carving the parallel-safe portion out of the original docs-and-skill-rewrite cluster.

### Cluster: skill-rewrite
- Stories: US-005b
- Phase: 4
- Depends on: full-task-port, phase-tree-port
- File-overlap evidence: shared=[]; exclusive=[.agents/skills/roadmap-and-overview/SKILL.md]; risk=low
- `execution_mode` rationale: SKILL.md procedures must reference a working task entry from the final schema (`kanbanCards`, `phaseTree` nodes, `lastTouched` dual-update). Running before US-003/US-004 risks SKILL examples drifting from the eventual data file. Phase 4 forces the dependency. Sole owner of `.agents/skills/roadmap-and-overview/SKILL.md` — zero file overlap with any other cluster, so the only cost of Phase 4 placement is wall time, not parallelism.

Parallel handoff: `/implement-with-ralph --from-plan <plan_job_dir>/plan.md --parallel --suggested-decomposition <plan_job_dir>/suggested-decomposition.json`
